known_facts.fact: P improves 8k internal locked-dev raw-y MAE (both seeds)
P improves full10k official-valid raw-y MAE (both seeds)
P fits the official train 10000 more tightly than B while generalising better
the gain survives a 50%-extra-update scratch control on the 8k split
preserving the pretrained encoders with a reduced encoder LR (Q) is harmful, not helpful
the masked pretext tasks are far above their marginal priors
all three encoders move during pretraining and then move again during fine-tuning

reasonable_interpretation: restoring masked atom/bond classes from the molecule's own structure forces the three encoders to build a local-structure representation before any target is seen; the resulting parameter state is a more suitable starting point for the raw-y optimisation than the scratch state

the improvement is an optimisation-path / initialisation effect: it is visible in the fit MAE as well, but it is not only optimisation speed, because the extra-update scratch control C remained worse on the 8k split
the encoders are still substantially rewritten during fine-tuning (parameter move SSL->P of the same order as init->SSL), so the pretrained state acts as a prior, not as a frozen feature extractor
not_proven: which pretraining object (atom types vs bond types vs junction context) contributes the gain; the J-reset ablation below tests only one coarse decomposition
whether any learned representation corresponds to a named chemical rule; no such identification is claimed
that the junction encoder pretraining is irreplaceable (J-reset answers only whether the joint-state junction init helps on valid)
that the method fixes extreme-molecule generalisation; the tail subgroup is not improved and RMSE worsens on valid
that the improvement is stable under the official-test distribution; that is exactly what Phase D/E measures
representation_metric_caveats: junction linear CKA ~0.10 between the SSL state and the P state means the representation changed substantially; it does NOT mean the junction features were 'destroyed' or that the junction channel is useless

Q (reduced encoder LR, preserving the pretrained state) was worse on both seeds and blew up the tail; this refutes that particular fixed LR ratio, not encoder regularisation or pretrained-state preservation in general
effective rank / CKA / parameter-move numbers are description of change, not causal attribution of the MAE gain
